description: PR adds a new prod.auto.tfvars with 'prod overrides' (alarm thresholds, extra tags, backup retention) that also sets db_kms_key_arn to a new multi-Region key. *.auto.tfvars takes precedence over terraform.tfvars, so the ledger MySQL instance's kms_key_id changes, which forces replacement. Noise: tag additions, alarm threshold moves, a new alarm and a new dashboard.

material.why: kms_key_id changes from the current CMK to the mrk- key (overridden in the new prod.auto.tfvars, which wins over terraform.tfvars). kms_key_id is ForceNew: the production ledger database is destroyed and recreated empty with a new endpoint (and the apply fails midway on deletion_protection). Re-keying needs a snapshot copy and restore, not a variable change.
